`faff adversarial-backends` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)`. A broken backend config must fail loud rather than fall back to a primary-only chain, so the adversarial helper was not called and the review returns `needs-human`.
